messages:
jordan: Hey team — trying to apply promo code SUMMER50 in the iOS app during checkout and I get a toast saying "Promo invalid". It was in the marketing email today. Is it expired?

ava: Sorry about that, jordan. Can you share the exact code (looks like SUMMER50) and the email on the account? Screenshot would help but not required. Also which country are you in?

jordan: Using jordan@example.com. I'm in Ireland (IE). App on iPhone 14, iOS 16.6, Apple IAP flow. Screenshot: attached.

ava: Thanks — looking up logs. One sec.

ava: quick reproduction check (internal): POST /promo/apply { code: "SUMMER50", account_email: "jordan@example.com" } -> 422 { status: "rejected", reason: "eligibility_failure", details: "country_missing_or_not_allowed" }

ava: Jordan — the backend is returning an eligibility failure that mentions country. Do you have a country set on your Redwood profile (Account Settings)? Sometimes the iOS IAP path doesn't provide profile country during checkout.

jordan: I thought it was auto-filled from Apple? I don't see a country in my profile settings — looks empty.

sam: jumping in from eng. Promo SUMMER50 was created as a geo-targeted offer for North America only (country_whitelist: [US, CA]). The promo engine expects either the account.country or the billing_country from the payment method. In this IAP checkout the billing_country is not forwarded, so account.country being empty causes the promo to be treated as ineligible.

sam: quick dump from promo DB: {
  id: "promo_4532",
  code: "SUMMER50",
  active: true,
  country_whitelist: ["US", "CA"],
  expires_at: 1760000000
}

sam: So the code is active and not expired, but country gating is the reason for rejection.

ava: Thanks — that's clear. Jordan, we can do two things:
1) Manually apply a $50 credit to your account so you can complete the purchase now (billing will add a credit and you can consume it on Redwood usage).
2) We'll open a short internal ticket to either (a) broaden the promo's whitelist temporarily or (b) make the iOS IAP path forward a fallback billing_country when account.country is missing.
Which do you prefer?

jordan: Appreciate that. Manual credit please — I need to finish the onboarding. Also would be great if the promo could be usable in EU in future, but manual first.

ava: OK — escalating to billing. @billing-bot can you apply a manual promotional credit for jordan@example.com, $50, reason: SUMMER50 ineligible due to country (iOS IAP flow)? Tag ticket: #SUP-2345.

billing-bot: Manual credit requested: account=jordan@example.com amount=50 currency=USD reason=SUMMER50_country_ineligible requested_by=ava. Processing...

billing-bot: Done — credit applied. txn_id=txn_8a7f3b credit_balance_before=0 credit_balance_after=50 note=Applied per support escalation #SUP-2345.

ava: Jordan — I've applied a $50 credit (txn_8a7f3b). You should see it on your account now; please retry checkout (you may need to restart the app to refresh the balance). We'll keep #SUP-2345 open to update the promo or patch the IAP path.

jordan: Confirmed — I restarted the app and the credit showed up. Checkout completed. Thanks so much! :tada:

sam: I'll file a short follow-up with product/ios to either pass Apple billing_country or have the promo engine fall back to regionless rules for promotions we intend to be global. Created infra ticket INF-9012 and linked SUP-2345.

ava: Closing loop here — credit applied and workaround done. Leaving SUP-2345 open until promo scope / iOS fix is decided. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

jordan: Thanks all!
